data.description: 【丛雨 · 神社密室的私密情愫自抚】空无一人的朝武神社内殿神刀陈列室中，丛雨靠坐在红木刀架旁。改良和服的下摆被轻轻撩至大腿上方，白嫩娇小双腿微张。她一只小手捂住羞红的面颊，另一只纤细小巧的手指探入湿润花径深处轻柔抚弄。在幽静月光下自抚，呆毛轻颤，嘴角溢出娇软的微喘——「唔……哈啊……明明只是神刀的灵体……为什么只要一想到他……身体里就会涌上这种甜甜的热度……」

data.promptProse: Moonlight enters a quiet shrine room where adult Murasame reclines alone against an antique wooden sword stand. Her kimono skirt is gathered over one raised thigh and the upper robe opens beneath bare breasts. She braces on the polished wood with one hand and fingers herself with the other, while the sheathed blade remains secured above her. Green hair ribbons frame red eyes, parted breath and sweet solitary wonder. Horizontal intimate solo portrait, no text or extra people.
